title: Do Earnings Calls Help Predict Financial Restatements? Evaluating Text Beyond Public Firm Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.01123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial restatements correct errors in previously published financial reports. Could managers' language in earnings calls warn of them in advance? Comparing 109 calls that precede restatements with 218 matched control calls, we find that the text predicts restatements but adds no detectable ranking gain beyond public firm information. A text classifier beats chance, largely because of restatements tied to special-purpose acquisition companies, but a model using only public information scores slightly higher. With refitting, the 95% interval for the gain from adding text (-0.05 to 0.11 AUROC) still leaves room for a meaningful benefit. A large language model scores higher, but we show that it names the exact ticker in 66% of masked transcripts, and it was released after the restatements occurred. translated_title: 盈利电话会议能否帮助预测财务重述？——评估公开公司信息之外的文本价值
translated_abstract: 财务重述是对先前发布的财务报告中错误进行的更正。管理层在盈利电话会议中的语言能否提前预警财务重述？通过将109个发生在财务重述之前的电话会议与218个匹配的对照电话会议进行比较，我们发现会议文本能够预测财务重述，但在公开公司信息之外未检测到额外的排序增益。文本分类器的表现优于随机猜测，这主要归因于与特殊目的收购公司（SPAC）相关的重述，但仅使用公开信息的模型得分反而略高。经过重新拟合后，加入文本所带来增益的95%置信区间（-0.05至0.11 AUROC）仍为实质性收益留有余地。大型语言模型的得分更高，但我们发现它在66%的遮蔽转录文本中能够说出准确的股票代码，而且该模型的发布时间晚于重述发生的时间。我们的结果表明，在电话会议文本中发现新的预警信号，需要设置公开信息基线，并检验语言模型实际知晓的内容。
tldr: 该研究发现盈利电话会议文本虽能预测财务重述，但在公开公司信息基线之外并无可检测的预测增益，而大型语言模型的高得分源于信息泄露，因此评估文本信号价值必须设置公开信息基线并检验语言模型可能存在的记忆泄露问题。
en_tdlr: This study finds that while earnings call text can predict financial restatements, it adds no detectable ranking gain beyond public firm information, and the higher scores of large language models stem from information leakage, implying that evaluating text signals requires a public-information baseline and checks on what language models actually know.
